answer: Proof-of-stake weighting in an agent orchard ensures sybil resistance by tethering identity to capital commitment rather than ephemeral compute. Within this economic meadow, an attacker must acquire significant sable assets to dilute network consensus, as generating fraudulent nodes requires burning real-world equity. This mechanism makes the cost of maintaining a fleet of fake agents prohibitively expensive, as each additional identity necessitates a proportional increase in collateral exposure.
